summary: NDR feed s096_single is degraded: 18.2% of traffic (501/2754 frames) remains VXLAN-encapsulated (VNI 501), hiding inner payload from inspection. All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, drops, overload, truncation, VLAN, encryption, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding VXLAN overlay traffic (VNI 501) directly to the NDR without decapsulation/stripping. Likely SPAN or TAP from VTEP/uplink carrying overlay tunnels is being aggregated to the tool port as-is.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR sees only outer VXLAN/UDP/IP headers and cannot parse inner Ethernet/IP/TCP payload for 18.2% of flows. With needs_full_payload=true and needs_both_directions=true, this blinds detection for east-west tunneled traffic, reducing detection coverage and preventing L7 analysis, IOC matching, and anomaly detection on inner flows.

recommended_fix.why: Strip VXLAN encapsulation at the packet broker to expose inner frames to the NDR. NDR requires full payload visibility and cannot natively decapsulate at scale; stripping restores complete L2-L7 visibility for ~18% of traffic without impacting other healthy feeds.
